label: supervisor-probe
command:
import os,signal,time
pid=os.fork()
if pid == 0:
 signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIG_IGN)
 print("owned resistant descendant",os.getpid(),flush=True)
 time.sleep(30)
else:
 print("owned leader exited",os.getpid(),flush=True)
stdout:
owned leader exited 50874
owned resistant descendant 50875
failure: PermissionError: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted; cleanup: [Errno 1] Operation not permitted
